issues.problem: The note says asyaya is 'asi ya(ḥ) run together', but asi + yaḥ would not produce the printed form (sandhi gives 'asi ya ā'); a printed -y- before a points to asi + aya(...) (cf. the Ṛgveda parallel). Keep the flag as 'possible' but do not give the derivation as fact.
issues.fix: Manual: reword the flag's why as: printed form is not explained by asi + yaḥ; reading unsettled.

summary: Reviewed 54 units word by word. Core splits and cases are mostly sound, but 3 invented or wrong Sanskrit forms (u14 doṣāvastar, u39 jaritar, u42 trātar), bracketed glosses/unsupported additions in the Hindi of 12 units, one dropped word (u44 hotā), and several uncertain readings kept as manual decisions. No regrouping needed.
